summary: The source and durable tests are unchanged since round 1, which I approved. A promotion job ensures the production exe.dev template exists, and after a successful deploy a cleanup job removes templates older than production. F1 is fixed: `ControlPlaneAuth.test.ts` now mocks `@get-halo/client` with its leaf modules, loads, and runs its 2 tests. Both test tiers pass and every changed line is covered, so the change is ready.
